(Published by Authority) PART III — LANDS Land Acquisition Notices
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460) Notice under Section 7 My Reference No.: KDS/PJP/4/4/2/W/91. Ref. No. of the Ministry of Agriculture, Livestock, Lands and Irrigation : 4-3/18/2021/WS/335.

I hereby give Public notice, under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, as Amended by the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964, that the Government intends to acquire the land described below for a public purpose. Particulars of the land expected to be acquired: Two parcels of land in total extent of about 0.0174 Hectare (6.9 Perches), out of the land called Godahena Waththa mentioned as Lot Nos. 1 and 2 in the Cadastral Map bearing No. 321215 dated 16.10.2024 prepared by the Surveyor - General and situated in the Village called Godahena in Grama Niladhari Division No. 521 - Godahena in Poojapitiya Divisional Secretary's Division in Kandy District of the Central Province.

01. Lot No. 01 Name of the Land : Godahena Waththa; Extent of the Land : 0.0032 Hectare (1.3 Perches) Boundaries of the Land : North : Lot No. 115 of Preliminary Plan No. A 2054; East : Lot No. 115, 132 of Preliminary Plan No. A 2054 and Lot No. 2 of this Plan; South : Lot No. 115, 132 of Preliminary Plan No. A 2054 and Lot No. 2; West : Lot No. 115 of Preliminary Plan No. A 2054 Names and Addresses of Claimants - 1. Boundaries of the Land : North : Lot No. 01 and Lot No. 115 of Preliminary Plan No. A 2054; East : Lot No. 115 and 132 of Preliminary Plan No. A 2054; South : Lot No. 132 of Preliminary Plan No. A 2054; West : Lot No. 132 and 115 of Preliminary Plan No. A 2054 Names and Addresses of Claimants - 1. Mrs. W. M. Loku Menike, No. 132, Godahena, Dolapihilla 2. Mr. W. M. Tikiri Banda, No. 132, Godahena, Dolapihilla 3. Mr. W. M. Ranasingha Banda, No. 132, Godahena, Dolapihilla 4. Mr. W. M. Herath Banda, No. 132, Godahena, Dolapihilla All persons interested in the aforesaid lands are hereby required to appear personally, or by agents, duly

authorized in writing, before me at the Divisional Secretariat, Poojapitiya on 19th of March 2025 at 10.00 a.m.. Further, they are hereby requested to notify me in writing (in duplicate) on or before the 12th of March 2025 the nature of their interests in the land, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said lands, the amount of compensation and particulars on how the said compensation was calculated. Deeds and other relevant documents with regards to the claim are to be presented during the inspection. D. M. S. K. Dൾൾ඀ൺඅൺ, Divisional Secretary, Poojapitiya. At Divisional Secretariat Poojapitiya, On 22nd of January, 2025.
